headline: Executive session to interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee will hold an executive session to consider or interview applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position. The Chair will then announce whether the open session will reconvene after the executive session.
items: Proposed Executive Session pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8), to consider or interview applicants for employment by a preliminary screening committee, if the Chair declares that an open meeting will have a detrimental effect in obtaining qualified applicants; Executive Session will be used for interviews for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position
Announcement by the Chair whether the Open Session will reconvene following Executive Session
location: Fogg Room, Beverly Public Library, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915
transcript:
# BEVERLY CITY COUNCIL
# BUDGET/MANAGEMENT ANALYST PRELIMINARY SCREENING COMMITTEE
Monday, October 5, 2026, 9:00 A.M.
Beverly Public Library
Fogg Room
32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915

## AGENDA

A. Regular/Open Session

B. Call to Order

C. Proposed Executive Session pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8), to consider or interview applicants for employment by a preliminary screening committee, if the Chair declares that an open meeting will have a detrimental effect in obtaining qualified applicants. Executive Session will be used for interviews for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.

D. Announcement by the Chair whether the Open Session will reconvene following Executive Session.
